recap.text: Tally, a level 63 Bopca Protector with a paper hat and a smell of wet moss, serves murgh vindaloo and garlic and spinach naan to Carl. He gives Donut plain white yogurt and five plates of salmon pâté, addressing her as Your Royal Highness. Tally answers only questions about safe rooms and explains that the company saps planets dry. Donut uses her charisma to make Tally provide the salmon.

beats.headline: Tally knows you are new here
beats.text: For the record: Tally, Bopca Protector, level 63, caretaker of the safe room, non-combatant. Paper hat, blue apron, a nametag, brown hair with a green tinge, a smell of wet moss, a Slavic accent. The dungeon opened without warning, so Tally is not ready, but he has been preparing for many years to cook for human crawlers. He is not prepared for a cat. The human asks for spice four on a human scale and receives murgh vindaloo over biryani, with garlic and spinach naan.
beats.gist: Tally, a level 63 Bopca Protector, serves murgh vindaloo, biryani, and garlic and spinach naan.

beats.headline: Your Royal Highness
beats.text: Tally serves the cat plain white yogurt and addresses her as Your Royal Highness; a fresh salmon has been special ordered for her waking. She instructs him to ensure the best-appointed room. "Of course, Your Highness." He apologises for the lack of lamb, taken for a mob in preparation for the floor below. He is not in every safe room: when this floor collapses he moves to a random floor, and when that collapses he moves down, until he is no longer needed.
beats.gist: Tally serves the cat white yogurt and orders a fresh salmon for her waking.

beats.headline: Safe room questions only
beats.text: Crawler Carl tries general questions about the dungeon. Tally refuses them. He answers only questions that directly concern safe rooms. A personal space, once bought, transfers from level to level and from safe space to safe space, and the accessories are best bought early, because some only upgrade when the space goes down a level. Across the table, Crawler Donut is on her third plate of salmon pâté.
beats.gist: Tally refuses Carl's general questions and answers only those concerning safe rooms.

beats.headline: They came, and I went
beats.text: Tally comes out from behind the counter to watch the premiere at their booth and declares it no good way to watch. He did not like last season: people broken into groups, told their loved ones would be safe if they killed the others. Safe, and not safe. That company saps a planet dry and leaves it without atmosphere. Borant at least gives people a chance. Was he a crawler? No. Sometimes they offer to take people instead of mining the world. They came, and he went. Very long ago.
beats.gist: Tally tells people that Borant offers to take people instead of mining worlds.

beats.headline: Five plates of salmon
beats.text: Following a goblin she has just charmed into guiding them, Crawler Donut explains her method. Mordecai told her that the higher her charisma, the easier it is to get people to do what she wants: anyone who can speak, whose dot is not red, who is not a boss or very high level. "How do you think I've been getting Tally to give me five plates of salmon this whole time?"
beats.gist: Crawler Donut explains she uses charisma to get Tally to give her five plates of salmon.
